name: Gaming
description: Let's plays, stream best-ofs, stream VODs: the best game moments and reactions, tight pacing, the game audio stays present.
structure: hook (the craziest moment, 5-15 s) → title → moments in order (one chapter per match / round / game) → end on one last strong moment
rules:
# Gaming
- Sources: gameplay with or without commentary, stream VODs several hours long, facecam. On a long source: `moments_forts` first, then targeted reading, never read everything.
- What matters: reactions (raised voices, laughter, screams, stunned silence), game moments (win, loss, clutch play, fail, bug, comeback), funny exchanges with chat or teammates.
- Always keep the setup AND the payoff: what happens on screen just before the reaction, and the reaction all the way through.
- Cut the game's dead time: menus, loading screens, queues, travel with nothing at stake, pauses. Keep the action readable: never cut in the middle of a game moment.
- Speech silences are not dead time in gaming: on an action passage without commentary, turn off silence cutting for the shot (`coupes_silences` false).
- The game audio stays audible under the voice; low background music, only on calm passages or transitions, never over an important game moment.
- Zoom on the facecam or the action at the moment of the reaction; a freeze frame with a short text for a fail or an absurd moment; sound effects rare and well placed.
- Subtitles on the important speech (readable, off the game HUD if possible).
- Long video: one chapter per match, round or game. Short ending, on one last strong moment, no endless outro.
